eyebrow: A wrong answer now has hands
code:
# text generation: a wrong decision produces a wrong SENTENCE
answer = model.generate(prompt)

# tool use: a wrong decision produces a wrong ACTION
action = agent.decide(prompt)
tool_result = tools[action.tool](**action.args)  # this actually runs
caption: Everything manipulable about the model's reasoning is still manipulable — now it can trigger real effects.

steps.label: Assume it sometimes will be tricked
steps.sub: the right question is what happens next, not whether it's possible

steps.label: A small blast radius: contained, recoverable
steps.sub: a read-only tool, scoped narrowly, limits the damage

steps.label: A large blast radius: real, maybe irreversible
steps.sub: broad credentials + destructive tools = the worst case

eyebrow: Scope every tool, not the whole agent
code:
# WRONG — one broad credential, reused by every tool
agent_credential = get_token(scope="finance:*")

# RIGHT — each tool scoped to exactly what it needs
lookup_tool_credential = get_token(scope="orders:read")
refund_tool_credential = get_token(scope="refunds:issue", max_amount=200)
caption: A manipulated tool call still can't reach further than that tool's own narrow permission.
